results.description:
Witchcraft! — The Solo Card Game of Strategy & Dark Magic
Lead your coven and protect the village in this thrilling solitaire card game where every choice could be your last.

THE ULTIMATE WITCHCRAFT SOLITAIRE EXPERIENCE
In Witchcraft!, darkness has fallen over Wildegrens. Monsters lurk in the shadows, harvests wither, and villagers vanish without a trace. As the leader of a witches' coven, you must wield your magic to save the village — but beware: exposing yourself could send you to the stake.
This solitaire card game puts you in constant dilemmas where the balance between power and secrecy decides everything. Can you master the art of witchcraft without getting caught?

KEY FEATURES
- Solitaire card game — Strategic 20–40 minute sessions, perfect for playing anytime
- Build your coven — Recruit witches from different families, each with unique abilities
- Face epic challenges — Battle monsters, complete quests, and prove your worth
- Convince the jury — Three judges will decide: hero or wicked witch?
- Deep strategy — Manage your hand, plan your moves, and press your luck
- Campaign mode — Immerse yourself in a dark witchcraft world where magic is real

DIGITAL BOARD GAME — FULL EXPERIENCE
Enjoy the complete digital adaptation of the award-winning board game by Salt and Pepper Games, now on your mobile device. A board game experience reimagined for solo play, featuring stunning illustrations by Albert Monteys that bring a magical and perilous world to life.
Built on the acclaimed hidden-role mechanics of Resist!, this witchcraft board game delivers the depth and tension of tabletop gaming in the palm of your hand.

PERFECT FOR
-  Fans of solitaire and strategic card games
- Lovers of dark fantasy and witchcraft themes
- Solo players seeking deep, immersive card game experiences
- Board game enthusiasts looking for a premium digital adaptation
- Players who love witchcraft-themed solitaire challenges

AWARD-WINNING DESIGN
Designed by Trevor Benjamin, Roger Tankersley, and David Thompson — the same team behind the acclaimed Resist!

Developed by mantita | Published by Salt and Pepper Games

Download Witchcraft! now and prove that magic isn't evil. The ultimate witchcraft solitaire card game awaits — the fate of Wildegrens is in your hands.
